title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Benefit Table: Courtesy Plan Supplement in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards adds a plan supplement to a courtesy credit for late fulfilment according to the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account.

## Rule

The courtesy plan supplement is 750 points when the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Summit, 300 points when it is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime, and nothing on any other plan. The supplement is added to the courtesy credit for the late redemption, in whole points.

The record read is the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account.

## Supplement by plan

| Plan of the linked personal account | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Summit | 750 points |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 300 points |
| Pocketwire Prime | 300 points |
| Pocketwire Plus | nothing |
| Pocketwire Core | nothing |
| Pocketwire Lite | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- A linked personal account on Pocketwire Plus, a paid plan, receives nothing: only Summit, Onyx and Prime are named.
- The supplement turns on the plan alone; the account's deposits play no part in it.
